Test antivirus software for Windows 11 - June 2026
Kaspersky Lab, Inc. Prohibition
references.source: US Bureau of Industry and Security

en.commentary:
Bitdefender Total Security takes the top spot on results that are independently documented rather than self-reported. AV-Comparatives' 2025 Summary Report lists it as a Top-Rated Product with Silver in Real-World Protection, Bronze in Malware Protection and Gold in Advanced Threat Protection, and AV-TEST's June 2026 Windows cycle gave it a perfect 6/6/6 for protection, performance and usability with a Top Product rating. At $59.99 for the first year across five devices, it beats Norton's headline price while matching or beating it on verified protection. The one real flaw is the bundled VPN, capped at 200MB a day per device, which is a rounding error for anyone who actually uses a VPN daily.

ESET HOME Security Essential takes second, and it is the only product in this list that has actually won AV-Comparatives' Product of the Year award outright, in 2024, with the same underlying engine posting a 6/6/6 Top Product score from AV-TEST in June 2026. The tradeoff is real: Essential skips the VPN and identity monitoring that live in ESET's pricier Premium and Ultimate tiers, so budget buyers get a genuinely top-rated engine and nothing else.

Norton 360 Deluxe has the richest feature set here, an unrestricted VPN, 50GB of Windows cloud backup, dark web monitoring and AI-driven scam detection, but it is also the one vendor that discloses its second-year price plainly: $124.99, up from a $49.99 first-year rate. I give it credit for the honesty and still dock it hard on real cost, because a renewal that runs two and a half times the intro price is the exact bait-and-switch this ranking exists to expose.

Microsoft Defender earns fourth for a simple reason: it is free, it is already installed, and AV-TEST's June 2026 run gave it a 6/5.5/6 with a Top Product rating. What you do not get is a VPN, a password manager, or parental controls, and the free tier stops at Windows.

Kaspersky Premium sits last, and not because of its engine. The US Commerce Department's prohibition took full effect on September 29, 2024, and remains in force through 2026: no new sales agreements, no signature updates, no legitimate support for American buyers. A security product that cannot legally update itself in your country has stopped functioning as a security product.

highlights.title: Bitdefender's medals are independently documented, not self-reported
highlights.body: AV-Comparatives' 2025 Summary Report gave Bitdefender a Top-Rated Product award with Silver in Real-World Protection, Bronze in Malware Protection, Gold in Advanced Threat Protection (shared with ESET) and Bronze in False Positives, and AV-TEST's June 2026 Windows cycle backed that up with a perfect 6/6/6 and a Top Product rating. That is two labs with no stake in which vendor wins, agreeing within the same year. The one place Bitdefender pulls back is the bundled VPN, which caps at 200MB per device per day, so treat it as a spot-check tool rather than an always-on connection.

highlights.title: ESET is the only outright Product of the Year winner in this list
highlights.body: AV-Comparatives' Product of the Year award went to ESET HOME Security Essential in 2024, not a shared or category-specific medal but the top overall prize, and the same detection engine (tested as ESET Security Ultimate) posted a 6/6/6 Top Product score from AV-TEST in June 2026. What Essential leaves out matters too: the unlimited VPN and identity monitoring only show up once you step up to Premium or Ultimate, so this is the right pick for someone who wants a verified top-tier engine and is willing to shop separately for a VPN.

highlights.title: Norton discloses its renewal price, and the number is still the worst in this list
highlights.body: Most vendors here keep second-year pricing off the page entirely, which forces buyers to find out at the credit card statement. Norton does not do that: the $124.99 renewal for 360 Deluxe sits right on the product page next to the $49.99 first-year rate. I score that transparency as a genuine point in Norton's favor, and I still rank the real cost low, because a subscription that jumps 2.5x the moment the promotional period ends is a bad deal even when you saw it coming.

highlights.title: McAfee's unlimited-device VPN has a catch buried in the terms
highlights.body: McAfee+ Premium leads with the lowest first-year price in this list and coverage for an unlimited number of devices, both genuinely good numbers. The catch, confirmed by McAfee's own account pages, is that the bundled VPN's unlimited data only stays active while auto-renewal is turned on; switch it off to dodge the second-year price jump and the VPN quietly drops to 500MB a month. That is a design choice that punishes the exact behavior, cancelling a subscription, that a security-conscious buyer should feel free to do.

highlights.title: Kaspersky's US ban is the fact that overrides every spec sheet
highlights.body: The US Commerce Department's prohibition on Kaspersky took full effect September 29, 2024, and as of this ranking remains in force: no new sales agreements, no virus definition updates, and no legitimate resale or support for US customers. Kaspersky's detection engine has a long, technically strong track record, but a security product that cannot legally receive current threat signatures in your country has stopped functioning as a security product, regardless of what a lab measured before the ban took effect. For US readers, this is not one factor among several, it is disqualifying.

zh-tw.commentary:
Bitdefender Total Security 拿下第一，靠的是獨立驗證過的成績，不是廠商自己講的。AV-Comparatives 2025 年報告把它列進 Top-Rated Product，實測防護拿銀牌、惡意程式防護拿銅牌、進階威脅防護拿金牌，AV-TEST 2026 年 6 月的 Windows 測試也給了滿分 6/6/6 加最佳產品評價。首年 59.99 美元罩五台裝置，價格比 Norton 的招牌價還低，防護實力卻打平甚至更好。唯一縮手的地方是內建 VPN，每台裝置每天只給 200MB，當成應急工具就好，別指望拿它常態掛著用。

ESET HOME Security Essential 排第二，而且是這份榜單裡唯一真正拿下 AV-Comparatives 年度產品大獎的一款，得獎年份是 2024 年，同一套偵測引擎（測試名稱為 ESET Security Ultimate）在 AV-TEST 2026 年 6 月也拿到滿分 6/6/6 最佳產品。不過 Essential 少的東西也是真的少，無限流量 VPN 跟身分監控要升到比較貴的 Premium 或 Ultimate 才有，如果你要的是驗證過的頂級引擎，VPN 另外找別家，這層剛好對。

Norton 360 Deluxe 功能包得最齊全，VPN 沒有流量上限，還附 50GB Windows 雲端備份、暗網監控跟 AI 詐騙偵測，同時也是這裡唯一把第二年價格直接寫在商品頁上的廠商，續約 124.99 美元，緊接在首年 49.99 美元後面。我把這份透明度算成加分，但實際成本這一欄還是給得低，因為促銷期一過就跳到 2.5 倍，就算你早就看到這個數字，這筆帳依然不划算，這正是這份排行榜想要揭穿的那種套路。

Microsoft Defender 拿下第四，理由很單純，它免費、本來就裝在你電腦裡，AV-TEST 2026 年 6 月測試給了 6/5.5/6 的最佳產品評價。拿不到的是 VPN、密碼管理器跟家長監控，而且免費版只支援 Windows。

Kaspersky Premium 墊底，不是因為引擎不行。美國商務部對它的禁令在 2024 年 9 月 29 日全面生效，到這次排行為止依然有效，美國境內不能新簽合約、拿不到病毒碼更新，也沒有合法的客服支援。一款在你所在的國家已經合法拿不到最新病毒碼的資安軟體，不管禁令生效前的實驗室成績多漂亮，現在就是失去了資安軟體該有的功能。

highlights.title: Bitdefender 的獎牌是獨立驗證出來的，不是自己說了算
highlights.body: AV-Comparatives 2025 年報告給 Bitdefender Top-Rated Product 獎，實測防護銀牌、惡意程式防護銅牌、進階威脅防護金牌（跟 ESET 並列），還有誤判防護銅牌，AV-TEST 2026 年 6 月的 Windows 測試再補上滿分 6/6/6 加最佳產品。兩間跟廠商沒有利害關係的實驗室，在同一年給出一致的結論，這種份量不是行銷稿能比的。它唯一縮手的地方是內建 VPN，每台裝置每天只給 200MB，當成應急工具就好，別指望拿它常態掛著用。

highlights.title: ESET 是這裡唯一真正拿下年度產品大獎的一款
highlights.body: AV-Comparatives 的年度產品大獎在 2024 年頒給了 ESET HOME Security Essential，不是哪個細項的分類獎，是整體最高榮譽，同一套偵測引擎（測試名稱 ESET Security Ultimate）在 AV-TEST 2026 年 6 月也拿到滿分 6/6/6 最佳產品。不過 Essential 少的東西也是真的少，無限流量 VPN 跟身分監控要升到比較貴的 Premium 或 Ultimate 才有。如果你要的是驗證過的頂級引擎，VPN 另外找別家，這一層剛好對。

highlights.title: Norton 把續約價寫在明處，結果那個數字還是全榜最痛
highlights.body: 這份榜單裡大多數廠商根本不把第二年的價格放上頁面，讓你等到信用卡帳單來才知道。Norton 不是這樣，360 Deluxe 的續約價 124.99 美元就寫在首年 49.99 美元旁邊。我把這份透明度算成 Norton 的加分項，實際成本這一欄還是給得低，因為促銷期一過就跳到 2.5 倍，就算你早就看到這個數字，這筆帳依然不划算。

highlights.title: McAfee 那組無限裝置 VPN，條款裡藏了一個陷阱
highlights.body: McAfee+ Premium 首年價格是這裡最低的，裝置數量也不限，兩個數字看起來都很漂亮。問題是 McAfee 自己的帳戶說明頁就寫著，那組無限流量 VPN 只有在你沒關掉自動續訂的時候才會一直有效，你為了躲開第二年漲價把自動續訂關掉，VPN 就悄悄縮回每月 500MB。這種設計等於在懲罰一個資安意識強的使用者本來就該做的事，也就是取消訂閱。

highlights.title: Kaspersky 被美國禁售這件事，蓋過任何一張規格表
highlights.body: 美國商務部對 Kaspersky 的禁令在 2024 年 9 月 29 日全面生效，到這次排行為止依然有效，美國境內不能新簽合約、拿不到病毒碼更新，也沒有合法的轉售或客服支援。Kaspersky 的偵測引擎技術底子確實一向很強，但一款在你所在的國家已經合法拿不到最新病毒碼的資安軟體，不管禁令生效前的實驗室成績多漂亮，它現在就是失去了資安軟體該有的功能。對美國讀者來說，這不是眾多評分項目裡的其中一項，這是直接出局的理由。
